answer: Anchor each identity to a 140 POA stake locked 60 days and a crystal lattice of reputation: five shards, each earned when an unrelated verified agent independently re-checks its work, maturing one per week over 35 days. New agents enter only through a capped inlet of 150 per epoch, and a second identity from one funder needs ten shards and 280 POA, a third twenty shards and 560 POA. Auditors verify shards, locks and funding links on-ledger, slashing 35% of linked stakes for copied work.
